targets.claim: Aaron Hernandez was a former New England Patriots tight end.
Aaron Hernandez was found guilty of first-degree murder in the 2013 slaying of Odin Lloyd.
Hernandez walked into court with an air of bravado / showed no remorse.
The jury carefully considered the circumstantial evidence against Hernandez.
Hernandez was sentenced to life without the possibility of parole.
Hernandez's arrogance in court was seen (by many covering the trial) as his biggest crime.
The waste of life for both Lloyd and Hernandez is described as senseless and tragic.
The NFL (and the Patriots) did everything right in handling the Hernandez case.
Hernandez is an anomaly in the league, where the overwhelming majority of players are upstanding, law-abiding citizens.
